name: Kendall Munk
bio_short: Kendall Munk is one of eight participants in Unframed at Holland Tunnel Revisited in Newburgh, a group that has met weekly for three years to paint outdoors together.
bio_long: Kendall Munk took part in Unframed (September 12 to October 11, 2026) at Holland Tunnel Revisited, 46 Chambers Street, Newburgh. The group behind the show is made up of people from different backgrounds who come together every week, in all seasons, to share a few hours of focused painting. The works on view were produced at those gatherings over three years. Munk exhibited alongside Tom Benson, Paul Chidester, Emily Hopkins, Nancy Manter, Mitch Markowitz, Michelle Marozik and Itty Neuhaus. Further biographical details have not yet been confirmed and will be added once supplied by the artist or the gallery.
practice: Participates in a weekly group painting practice; works in the exhibition were made during these gatherings.
